description.value:
Duel a rival through linked Holophones. Each builds a Rank 4 Solo (Complete Package: 62 STAT points, 86 Skill points, 2,550eb, no explosives), then you fight to the death in an arena of the GM's design. The fight stops only if both agree. The loser's Holophone burns out, destroyed until a Clinic replaces it, and they take a Brain Injury. It's cheaper than dying in the street, so people bet on it.

Publisher: Segotari
Cost: 20eb

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods
